name: Iris Nebula
notes: Story #326 new-record gap-fill (data/raw/gap_fills/README.md convention): a bright, well-known reflection nebula surrounding the young star HD 200775, not part of the Zucker et al. 2020 molecular-cloud compendium Stories #318/#324/#325 mined (that paper is specifically about molecular clouds, not reflection nebulae). Classification judgment call (issue's own explicit request): SIMBAD's primary catalog entry for the commonly-used identifier 'NAME Iris Nebula' resolves to NGC 7023 with otype 'OpC' (Open Cluster - the young embedded cluster, not the nebula itself); a live SIMBAD region search around that position found the nebula's own distinct entry, 'Ced 187' (Cederblad 187), otype 'RNe' (Reflection Nebula), just 0.026 deg away (same physical object, essentially coincident) - confirming this genuinely is a reflection nebula, physically distinct from the 5 already-loaded Messier hii_region records (M42/M8/M16/M17/M20), which are true ionized emission nebulae. Reflection nebulae are non-ionized dust clouds scattering starlight, not emission-line gas - a poor physical fit for hii_region. Classified as molecular_cloud instead, extending this catalog's own established precedent (Pipe Nebula, Coalsack Nebula) of using molecular_cloud for non-ionized diffuse dust/dark-nebula structures, not only literal star-forming molecular gas. Position/distance anchored to NGC 7023's own SIMBAD entry (co-located with Ced 187, the RNe-typed entry, at 0.026 deg separation) rather than Ced 187 itself, since NGC 7023 carries a real usable parallax (plx_value=2.905+/-0.077 mas -> 344.23+/-9.12 pc) while Ced 187 has none on file - the same 'named-nebula identifier resolves to a co-located companion object, use that object's own position/distance anyway' pattern issue #221 already documented for M8/M16/M17/M20 resolving to their embedded open clusters. 344 pc is comfortably under the issue's own unverified ~400pc estimate and the 800pc cap. visual.size_pc is an honest failure: no galdim_majaxis on file under any alias tried live (NAME Iris Nebula, NGC 7023, Ced 187, LBN 487, Cl VDB 139) - never fabricated. SIMBAD also carries a tangential-only proper-motion vector for the embedded cluster (no radial velocity on file); not carried into this record, matching this catalog's existing convention of leaving velocity unpopulated for every molecular_cloud/hii_region/supernova_remnant/planetary_nebula record to date (including the Messier-nebula-gap-fill batch, which resolved through this exact same SimbadResolver path).
